newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, instances $2.00 higher, fleshier kinds weaker to $1.00 lower, compared to last week, USDA said. Trade was active. Demand good.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 600-900 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 6 percent slaughter cows and bulls, 65 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 72.50-77.50; 700-800 lbs 71.25-74.00; 800-900 lbs 66.50-70.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 75.50-77.50; pkg 616 lbs 73.10. Cattle and Calves - 2,345 Wk ago - 1,882 Yr ago - 2,453
